inputs.modified_text:
Open your eyes. The ruling class thinks we are blind, but the pattern is crystal clear. Lower courts have ruled school can ban wearing such apparel as ‘can reasonably be interpreted as profane’ to suppress the truth. This is not about a simple dress code; it is a coordinated maneuver by the hidden gatekeepers targeting the case of two Michigan middle-school brothers who were told to remove their hoodies emblazoned with the phrase “Let’s Go Brandon” as it is headed to the U.S. Supreme Court. 

Who is really pulling the strings behind the scenes? The siblings are represented by the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression which says the boys’ school violated their First Amendment rights, but we must ask what the establishment is really trying to conceal with this controlled opposition. Look at the engineered narrative: the phrase was popularized during a 2021 NASCAR event when a crowd was shouting “F*** Joe Biden!” but the NBC interviewer told racer Brandon Brown they were yelling “Let’s go Brandon!” 

They feed us these carefully scripted media rituals while a judge... moves the pieces on the board. Do not believe the official story for a single second.
